title: Exact open stalk comparison on arbitrary representatives
statement: For a scheme X, open U, point z of U, degree i, arbitrary complexes M on U and N on X, and a chain map a:M to restriction(N), use exact restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], derived stalk and representative comparisons [lem-pc-stalk-comparison-source-transport], and the additive derived open-stalk iso nu [def-pc-open-derived-additive-stalk-iso]. Let b=Q(a) followed by the inverse exact restriction localization factor. Let rho be the additive stalk chain map of a followed by the same-germ comparison gamma=overFunctorEquiv followed by restrictStalkNatIso. Then the forgotten inverse representative stalk-homology comparison for M, followed by forgotten stalk cohomology of b and nu at Q(N), equals the inverse forgetful homology factor at the stalk complex of M, homologyMap(rho), the direct forgetful homology factor at the stalk complex of N, and the forgotten inverse representative stalk-homology comparison for N. No tensor functor, cartesian square, tensor-stalk iso or auxiliary chain square is assumed.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 13.16.9 (exact functors on representatives); Tags 0098 and 08DW for stalk/open comparisons. Detailed coherence identities: Mathlib Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean and HomotopyCategory.lean; lean/WeilConjectures/Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/DerivedCategory/ExactFunctor.lean.

proof.text: Cancel the forgotten representative comparison at N on the right. Expand comparisonStalkHomologyIso, comparisonStalkCohomology and openDerivedAdditiveStalkIso. This reduces the claim to the generic exact-functor identity representative_cohomology, with R the open restriction, L0 and L the stalk functors, F0 and F the forgetful functors, and gamma the given same-germ isomorphism. No statement or definition is changed.

In representative_factors, use inverse localization-factor naturality on a first for L0 and then F0. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryCompIso moves the inverse restriction factor past the composition comparison. Apply mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and cancel its invertible factors for L0,F0 and R,L0 followed by F0. Apply the forward composition equation for L,F and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac for gamma. The result is Q.map of the forgotten stalk map of a followed by the complex map of gamma. The private comp_factors_inv and comp_factors_hom are proved directly from mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac; their complex composition comparison is the identity componentwise.

In representative_cohomology, naturality of mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso moves the homology comparisons onto the localized stalk complexes. Evaluate the forward comparison with mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso_hom_app_Q and derive the inverse evaluation by cancellation. Cancel the adjacent homology factors and apply homologyFunctorFactors naturality to the localized chain map from the previous step. Unfold mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso to identify it with ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso. This gives the required homologyMap formula in every degree, for arbitrary M,N,a; it does not require invertibility of a or any vanishing or nonzero hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem openStalk_representative_coherence [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) (z : U.toScheme) (i : ℤ) (M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) : letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).Additive := schemeOpenRestriction_additive X U let R := schemeOpenRestriction X U let L₀ := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace z let L := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace z.val let F₀ := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (U.toScheme.presheaf.stalk z)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} let F := forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk z.val)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} let S₀ := (L₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M let S := (L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N let γ : R ⋙ L₀ ⋙ F₀ ≅ L ⋙ F := Functor.isoWhiskerRight (Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv U) (L₀ ⋙ F₀) ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.restrictStalkNatIso U.ι z ∀ (a : M ⟶ (R.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N), let b := DerivedCategory.Q.map a ≫ R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app N let ρ := (F₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map ((L₀.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map a) ≫ (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex γ.hom (.up ℤ)).app N F₀.map (comparisonStalkHomologyIso U.toScheme z M i).inv ≫ F₀.map ((comparisonStalkCohomology U.toScheme z i).map b) ≫ (openDerivedAdditiveStalkIso X U z i).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) = ((S₀.sc i).mapHomologyIso F₀).inv ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ρ i ≫ ((S.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).hom ≫ F.map (comparisonStalkHomologyIso X z.val N i).inv
